item.prompt: Explain what primary clustering is and why linear probing produces it. Then state one way double hashing reduces it.

answer_key.reference_answer: Primary clustering is the growth of contiguous runs of occupied slots. Linear probing causes it because every key that hashes into a run probes forward one slot at a time and lands at the end of that run, lengthening it, so the run attracts still more keys. Double hashing reduces it by making the step size depend on the key, so two keys that collide at the same slot probe different sequences instead of both walking the same consecutive slots.

item.explanation: Occupied runs grow because linear probing walks consecutive slots, and slide 11 shows this with 89 in slot 9, 49 in slot 0, 58 in slot 1 and 69 in slot 2. Double hashing varies the step per key, so colliding keys do not share one probe sequence.
